# Configuration

## How configuration works

ChromSimPipe is fully YAML-driven. All paths, locus coordinates, simulation
conditions, and cohesin parameters live in two files:

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `config/ChromSimConfig.yaml` | Cluster paths, locus definitions, run settings |
| `ChromSimSamplesheet.txt` | Per-condition CTCF peak files |

`configs/parameters.py` reads `config/ChromSimConfig.yaml` at import time and
exports named constants + helper functions that every script and Snakemake rule
uses. Nothing is hardcoded in the scripts.

## `config/ChromSimConfig.yaml` — full reference

```yaml
# --- Input data ---
hic:                                       # one entry per Hi-C map; names are your choice
  condition1:   /path/to/condition1.hic    # raw Hi-C in .hic format (KR-normalized)
  condition2:   /path/to/condition2.hic
genome:         /path/to/hg38.fa           # for FIMO CTCF orientation
samplesheet:    ChromSimSamplesheet.txt

# --- Locus definitions (multiple; one is ACTIVE at a time) ---
loci:
  chr1_fig1:
    chrom:  chr1
    start:  64200000
    end:    66200000
  chr4_fig1:
    chrom:  chr4
    start:  1700000
    end:    3700000
  chr6_fig1:
    chrom:  chr6
    start:  124100000
    end:    126100000
  chr16_sox8:
    chrom:  chr16
    start:  400000
    end:    2300000

# --- Active locus (one key from loci above) ---
active_locus: chr1_fig1

# --- Simulation settings ---
resolution:    1000     # bp per monomer
n_replicates:  3
n_shards:      4

# --- Tiling ---
tiling:
  n_copies: 28          # polymer is 28× the locus (for statistics)

# --- Cohesin model (Gabriele 2022 defaults) ---
smc_bond:
  lifetime:       75
  separation:     240
  ctcf_capture:   0.125
  ctcf_release:   0.0033
```

::: {.callout-tip}
Changing `active_locus` is all you need to switch analysis targets. Re-run
`bash setup_data.sh --skip-envs` to regenerate CTCF BEDs for the new locus,
then resubmit.
:::

## `configs/parameters.py` — exported API

Importing this module gives you:

```python
from configs.parameters import (
    ACTIVE_LOCUS,          # str: e.g. "chr1_fig1"
    LOCI,                  # dict: all locus defs
    CHROM,                 # str: e.g. "chr1"
    REGION_START,          # int: genomic start (bp)
    REGION_END,            # int: genomic end (bp)
    RESOLUTION,            # int: bp/monomer
    N_MONOMERS,            # int: (REGION_END - REGION_START) // RESOLUTION
    POLYMER,               # dict: polymer physics settings
    SMC_BOND,              # dict: cohesin bond settings
    TILING,                # dict: tile_size, chrom_size, padding, n_tiles
    SIM_RUN,               # dict: block counts, save interval, replicates
    SIMULATION_CONDITIONS, # list[dict]: one dict per condition
    ALL_PARAM_SETS,        # list[dict]: the cohesin params of each condition
    CTCF_TYPES,            # list[str]: CTCF sets used by the conditions
    CTCF_BEDS,             # dict: ctcf_type -> oriented BED path
    HIC_FILES,             # dict: hic_type -> .hic path
    MCOOL_FILES,           # dict: hic_type -> data/mcool/<hic_type>.cool
)
```

### Helper functions

```python
# Full condition dict (params, ctcf_type, compare_hic) by condition name
cond = get_condition("cond1_baseline")

# Print a table of all conditions
list_conditions()

# Oriented CTCF sites for a CTCF set (a ctcf_type, not a condition name)
positions, orientations = get_ctcf_arrays("condition1")

# The same sites repeated across every tile of the simulated polymer
positions, orientations = get_tiled_ctcf_arrays("condition1")

# Load a BED file into the CTCF set it belongs to (done automatically on import)
load_ctcf_from_bed("data/ctcf_beds/ctcf_oriented_hg38_condition1_chr1_64210000_66170000.bed",
                   condition="condition1")
```

## Simulation conditions

Conditions are defined in the `conditions:` list of
`config/ChromSimConfig.yaml`; `configs/parameters.py` reads them at import
time. The three example conditions:

```yaml
conditions:
  - name:         cond1_baseline
    params_name:  baseline
    lifetime:     75
    separation:   240
    ctcf_capture: 0.125
    ctcf_release: 0.0033
    ctcf_type:    condition1
    compare_hic:  condition1

  - name:         cond2_ctcf-only
    params_name:  ctcf_only
    # ... same cohesin settings ...
    ctcf_type:    condition2
    compare_hic:  condition2

  - name:         cond2_weak-ctcf
    params_name:  weak_ctcf
    ctcf_capture: 0.0625      # 0.5x the default
    # ...
    ctcf_type:    condition2
    compare_hic:  condition2
```

To add a condition, add an entry with a unique `name`. Its `ctcf_type` must
have a row in `ChromSimSamplesheet.txt`, and its `compare_hic` must be a key
under `hic:`. Snakemake picks new conditions up automatically.

## Profiles and SLURM settings

`profiles/slurm/config.yaml` sets cluster-level defaults:

```yaml
executor:         slurm
default-resources:
  slurm_account:  rc_dphansti_pi
  slurm_partition: general
  runtime:         4320          # 72 h max; per-rule overrides this
  mem_mb:          8000
  cpus_per_task:   1
```

GPU jobs override these via per-rule `resources:` blocks in the Snakefile.
